speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are a newborn presenting with feeding intolerance and bilious vomiting. This is a serious presentation that requires immediate investigation. To narrow down the cause, please tell me if you noticed any green (bilious) fluid coming from your baby's mouth before this started? Also, has your baby passed any stool since the symptoms began?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, 3050-g (6-lb 12-oz) male, six hours post delivery. The newborn has had several episodes of bilious vomiting and is intolerant to feeding since birth. Was born at term following an uncomplicated pregnancy, though the mother missed several prenatal checkups. The patient's older brother underwent surgery for pyloric stenosis as an infant.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Intestinal Malrotation with Volvulus. The onset of bilious vomiting within six hours of birth is a surgical emergency indicating midgut volvulus, which requires immediate confirmation via upper GI series and surgical intervention rather than further questioning.
